IC1: Subjects who, in the opinion of the investigator, can and will comply with the requirements of the protocol.
IC2: Written informed consent obtained from the subject prior to performing any study specific procedure.
IC3: A male [OR] or female between, and including, 18 and 50 years of age at the time of the first study visit.
IC4: Healthy subjects as established by medical history [AND]  and clinical examination before entering into the study. Healthy subjects with no medical conditions that, in the opinion of the investigator, prevents the subject from participating in the study.
IC5: Subjects must weigh at least 110 pounds (50 kg), but [NOT] not to present obesity (BMI < 32kg/m2).
IC6: Female subjects of [NOT] non-childbearing potential may be enrolled in the study. Non-childbearing potential is defined as pre-menarche [OR], current bilateral tubal [OR] ligation or occlusion [OR], hysterectomy [OR], bilateral ovariectomy [OR] or post-menopause.
IC7: has practiced adequate contraception for 30 days prior to vaccination, and
IC8: has a negative pregnancy test on the day of vaccination and
IC9: has agreed to continue adequate contraception during the entire treatment period  and for 1 month [OR], after completion of the vaccination series.
